```plato
    // The corner farthest along `direction`: each local axis independently takes
    // the sign of the direction's component on it.
    Support(b: Box3D, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var f = b.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var d = direction.Vector;
        return b.Center
            + f.X * (d.Dot(f.X) >= 0.0 ? b.Size.Width * 0.5 : b.Size.Width * -0.5)
            + f.Y * (d.Dot(f.Y) >= 0.0 ? b.Size.Height * 0.5 : b.Size.Height * -0.5)
            + f.Z * (d.Dot(f.Z) >= 0.0 ? b.Size.Depth * 0.5 : b.Size.Depth * -0.5);
    }
```

## Line 244

```plato
    // The support of a Minkowski sum is the sum of the supports: the core box's
    // extreme corner displaced by r along `direction`.
    Support(b: RoundedBox3D, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var f = b.Box.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        var d = direction.Vector;
        return b.Box.Center
            + f.X * (d.Dot(f.X) >= 0.0 ? e.X * 0.5 : e.X * -0.5)
            + f.Y * (d.Dot(f.Y) >= 0.0 ? e.Y * 0.5 : e.Y * -0.5)
            + f.Z * (d.Dot(f.Z) >= 0.0 ? e.Z * 0.5 : e.Z * -0.5)
            + d * b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
    }
```

```plato
    // The support of a Minkowski sum: the farther spine endpoint along `direction`,
    // displaced by r along it.
    Support(c: Capsule3D, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
        => (direction.Vector.Dot(c.A.PositionVector) >= direction.Vector.Dot(c.B.PositionVector)
            ? c.A : c.B) + direction.Vector * c.Radius;
```

```plato
    // The rim point of whichever cap faces `direction`: the axial extreme plus the
    // radial extreme, chosen independently.
    Support(c: Cylinder, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var a = c.Axis.Vector;
        var d = direction.Vector;
        var axial = a * (d.Dot(a) >= 0.0 ? c.Height * 0.5 : c.Height * -0.5);
        return c.Center + axial + RadialSupport(d, a, c.Radius);
    }
```

## Line 454

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 454](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L454).

```plato

    // Either the Apex or the extreme point of the base rim, whichever is farther
    // along `direction`. Exact because the cone is the convex hull of those two
    // features.
    Support(c: Cone, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var d = direction.Vector;
        var rim = c.BaseCenter + RadialSupport(d, c.Axis.Vector, c.Radius);
        return d.Dot(c.Apex.PositionVector) >= d.Dot(rim.PositionVector) ? c.Apex : rim;
    }
```

```plato
    // The support point of an ellipsoid: in its own frame the point is
    // A^2 d / |A d| with A the diagonal semi-axis matrix, which is the image under
    // A of the unit-sphere support in the direction A d.
    Support(e: Ellipsoid, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var d = direction.Vector.Transform(e.Orientation.Inverse);
        var a = e.SemiAxes;
        var scaled = Vector3D(a.X * d.X, a.Y * d.Y, a.Z * d.Z);
        var local = Vector3D(a.X * scaled.X, a.Y * scaled.Y, a.Z * scaled.Z)
            / scaled.Magnitude;
        return e.Center + WorldOffset(e.Orientation, local);
    }
```
